Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite sheet for a gentle Japanese birthday-month fortune mockup. Create EXACTLY 15 SEPARATE full-body mascot sprites, arranged strictly as FIVE COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, all evenly spaced with huge empty transparent gutters. Landscape canvas, high resolution. The SAME mascot in every cell: cute chubby cream-white bean-shaped creature with stubby arms and feet, two black dot eyes, blush pink cheeks, no ears, small smile, rounded toy-like soft glossy 3D clay rendering. Pastel but colorful props in sky blue, mint, yellow, pink, lilac. Every sprite is ONE CONNECTED silhouette including mascot and any physically held props; keep objects touching hands/body. No detached stars, sparkles, confetti, shadows, text, numbers, guides, labels, frames or background. ALL background including gutters is genuinely transparent alpha. Full equipment fully visible. Each sprite contained in central 65% of its imagined cell, never touching adjacent sprite. This is a sprite sheet, not a scene. Row-major order LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM is mandatory. The FIFTEEN actions are:
1. holding a sprouting green plant pot
2. organizing a little blue storage box
3. holding a yellow telephone handset
4. writing in a pink notebook
5. carrying a blue backpack, taking a step
6. holding a pink heart against chest
7. holding a small winding-path map
8. examining an open book with a magnifier touching the book
9. holding a handwritten-style blank letter envelope
10. hugging a steaming warm tea mug (steam attached to mug)
11. holding a pink blossom flower pot
12. stretching arms overhead, no props
13. holding a green watering can against body
14. holding a shiny compass
15. holding a yellow star against chest
